intended_object: One hard-coded subtree (part 54) of a computational certificate: a `CompactCellTree` of splits, cell leaves and Farkas "absurd" receipts, used to check a cover of the row-03 length cone in the genus-five Brill–Noether graph computation. I inferred this from the docstring, the name and the module.
explanation: This is not a mathematical object. The definition is a literal piece of certificate data: a tree whose nodes are split indices, whose leaves are cell indices with lists of constraint indices, and whose `absurd` leaves are indices of Farkas certificates. Its job is to help a verified check that a fixed affine cell cover handles the row-03 cone. It is an internal device of a proof, and no standard notion in the literature corresponds to it. So it cannot be faithful or unfaithful to any mathematical definition.
